descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper name (חֶבֶר II) meaning 'associate' or 'companion', borne by several OT individuals including Heber the Kenite, husband of Jael (Judg 4:11,17,21; 5:24), a descendant of Asher (Gen 46:17; Num 26:45; 1 Chr 7:31-32), and others in genealogical lists. Multilingual evidence is consistent: eng 'Heber/Chever', spa 'Jéber/Jever', hin 'हेबेर', arb 'حابِر', kor '헤벨/헤베르', swa 'Heberi'. The prepositional form (לְחֶבֶר 'to Heber') is a syntactic variant directing action toward the same named individual.
